subject: general
question: When was Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**December 2001.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana (VAMBAY)**

 
 
• It was introduced by the Prime Minister of India on **December 2, 2001.**
 
• It is a** government-funded scheme **for the development of** urban slum dwellers. **
 
• The main goal of this scheme is to improve the** housing problems **for those urban slum dwellers who lives below the poverty line by** providing them with shelters and access to community toilets.**
 
• It aims to raise the living standard of urban slum dwellers by providing them shelters and it also helps to foster a healthy environment by building toilets.
 
• So far, for VAMBAY government had already sanctioned a sum of **Rs.590.00 crore** and have allocated **2,13,066 shelters** as well as **28,753 Toilet Seats.**
 
• The implementation of the scheme VAMBAY is a partnership between the federal and the state governments, with each providing a** contribution of 50%. ​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, other than VAMBAY there are various others schemes for the development of urban slum dwellers such as National Slum Development Programme (NSDP) launched by the Prime Minister of India in August, 1996.
 
• By merging VAMBAY and NSDP an **Integrated Housing and Slum development Programme (IHSDP)** is launched by the government of India with the aim of **providing shelters** and all the **basic facilities to the urban slum dwellers**. 
 
• For the rural population of India, **Indira Awas Yojana was was launched by Rajiv Gandhi in 1985 to provide them shelters**.
